newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index eases in trendless market.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index eases in trendless market.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse share index Semdex eased by 0.27 points to 318.41 on Friday, reflecting a trendless trading session, brokers said.
Provisional traded volume was posted at 11.15 million rupees on 1,003,040 shares from 11.70 million rupees on 335,766 shares on Wednesday.

"The market continues to lack a general trend. Shares have been moving up and down on today's fixing without going in a definite general direction," a broker said. "This explains why the Semdex is only slightly down."
Some 65 percent of traded volume was in State Bank of Mauritius with foreign investors again seen buying the bank's stocks.

State Bank of Mauritius which reported earlier this week a 19 percent rise in pre-tax profit for the financial year ending 30 June 1996, currently attracts the majority of foreign investors' buying on the Mauritian bourse market.
State Bank climbed 10 cents to 8.60 rupees on 840,000 shares.
The rest of the market ended mixed on Friday.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 72 rupees on 4,720 shares.

In the Industry sector, Mauritius Oil Refineries gained 10 cents to 8.30 rupees on 8,547 shares while building blocks manufacturer United Basalt Products eased 10 cents to 25.40 rupees on 1,250 shares.
Investment stocks Promotion And Development (PAD) fell by 60 cents to 15 rupees on 9,462 shares and Policy was 10 cents lower to 3.30 rupees on 26,386 shares.

Consolidated Investment Trust (CIT) lost 20 cents to 9 rupees on 13,021 shares, Fincorp Investment was stable at 71 rupees on 4,298 shares and Mauritius Development Investment Trust (MDIT) remained at 7.40 rupees on 29,150 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Desert Alma (ordinary) surged by 3.50 rupees to 88.50 on 52 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 35 rupees on 1,250 shares.
Conglomerate Rogers was flat at 89 rupees on 9,100 shares.
Grand Baie Hotel was 90 cents higher to 34.10 rupees on 4,275 shares and Sun Resorts was unchanged at 35.50 rupees on 13,896 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius remained at 50 rupees on 1,230 shares. Caudan Debentures was unchanged at 1,085 rupees on 500 units traded.
